samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
    <description>A clock generator module that generates a periodic clock signal based on the specified period.</description>
    <ports>
        <output id="clk">The output clock signal generated by the module.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="PERIOD">The period of the clock signal, which determines the frequency of the clock.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initial block to initialize the clock signal
        initial begin
            $display("Initializing clock generator");
            clk = 0;
        end
        
        // Always block triggered on the positive edge of the clock
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Toggle the clock signal after half of the specified period
            if ($time >= ((PERIOD/2)*10)) begin
                clk <= ~clk;
                $display("Toggled clock signal");
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
